findings.issue: The mandated full regression `./gradlew build` FAILED on this machine with 2 failures, both `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` at default parallelism: `:compose-application:linkReleaseFrameworkIosSimulatorArm64` (Kotlin/Native DevirtualizationAnalysis) and `:aos-application:minifyReleaseWithR8`. T-14's own TAC-2 already encodes `--max-workers=1`. aggregateDiffFindings.issue: Clean: the batch id (which embeds a device id) is sanitised with `Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]")` before it becomes a directory name, and that is covered by `writeSanitisesABatchIdSoItCannotEscapeTheHistoryRoot`. No HTTP client, no new permission, nothing logged beyond ids and paths — NFR-4 holds by construction. Residual (accepted by FR-36, not a defect): frame PNGs, per-annotation crops, hierarchy XML (which can contain on-screen text) and prompts are stored in plaintext under ~/.rectify/history with no delete or retention UI and no prune, so the on-disk footprint and its exposure grow without bound.

The plan's 'added latency on resolveAndSend (p95) <= 150 ms' is modelled, not measured. `postSideEffect(SendComplete)` is now gated behind cropAndScale + PNG encode + up to ~1 MB of file writes + one DB transaction; the ordering is deliberate and correct (history before the toast, failure dropped), and all of it is off the UI thread (Dispatchers.Default / Dispatchers.IO, NFR-14 satisfied by inspection), but the user-visible toast delay has never been timed. Only a GUI run can close this.

Every persisted batch's inline thumbnail rides in reduced Orbit state forever, and nothing prunes history. The budget ('<= 10 MB of thumbnail bytes at 1000 rows') follows from the measured 541-byte fixture thumbnail and the 8 KB cap, so it is plausible, but it is an extrapolation: no test and no run exercises a large history. `ByteArray` identity equality also means each DB emission produces a new state instance regardless of content; mitigated, not eliminated, by `key = { it.id }` and `remember(entry.id)`.

The Notes/Payload behaviour pre-dates this branch and no AC covers it, but the asymmetry is new and visible, and the AC-34 comment ('SidebarTabs renders any non-null count, so a zero would paint a literal "0"') documents exactly the bug the siblings still have.

First impl-on-impl module edge in the repo: `data-repository-impl` previously depended only on `*-api` modules (dataPreferenceApi, dataDeviceApi, dataDatabaseApi). It now compiles against `data-database-impl` because `.claude/rules/database.md` places entity-specific datasources in `-impl` (and the Room `@Entity` wire types with them). The rule amendment in this diff documents the `source/entity/` exception but not the new dependency direction; worth an explicit note so the next planner does not treat it as precedent for arbitrary impl->impl edges.
